images.title: Slide to find the balanced states
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the rice and wheat map: two threshold handles on the scale mark the balanced band near zero.
images.composition: One long horizontal scale bar across the middle of the frame with two round handles near the centre; the band between them is highlighted. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A long horizontal bar, about two thirds of the frame wide, with thin dark outline. From the left end to the first handle it is amber (#E69F00) with the word 'wheat' above it; from the second handle to the right end it is teal (#0072B2) with the word 'rice' above it. Between the handles it is reddish purple (#CC79A7, light) with the word 'balanced' above it. Two round white handles with dark outlines sit on the bar at −20 and +20. Below the bar, four numbers: '−100' at the left end, '−20' under the left handle, '+20' under the right handle, '+100' at the right end. Exactly 1 bar, 2 handles, 3 zones.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: States with values close to zero are balanced; the handles decide how close counts.
images.description: Shows the core move of the rice and wheat map: two threshold handles on the scale mark the balanced band near zero.
images.context: Threshold slider of the infographic tool; −20 to +20 is one example setting.
images.teaching_notes: The threshold is a choice, not a fact from the map; the child can move it.

image_decisions.why: The practice tool's threshold slider is its key move; this picture shows it in its simplest setting.
